About This Game

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

The game features realistic combat with firearms, blood effects, injury mechanics such as bleeding and limb damage, and occasional strong language.

    • OS: Windows 10
    • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or similar
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1660 or similar
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 80 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700F or better
    • Memory: 64 GB RAM
    • Graphics: RTX 4070 or better
